value.name: Asha dismisses the apology lightly
value.description: Asha thanks the speaker in a deliberately weightless way, signaling that she is not granting the apology much significance.
evidence: "Thank you," Asha said. She let the thank-you carry no weight at all. It was the lightest possible acknowledgment, the kind a court reporter might give to a question repeated for the record.

value.name: Asha assigns Marcus desk photography
value.description: Asha instructs Marcus to photograph the desk contents, empty drawers, and rolltop interior for later inventory comparison.
evidence: "Marcus. Please photograph the contents of the desk as they currently stand, and the empty drawers, and the interior of the rolltop. We'll inventory what's here against the executor's list this afternoon."

value.name: Asha asks Rosa to search the house
value.description: Asha asks Rosa to accompany her through the rest of the house and identify any place Mrs. Serrano may have hidden a green folder.
evidence: "Rosa. Would you walk through the rest of the house with me and point out anywhere else Mrs. Serrano might have kept a green folder."

value.name: Rosa withdraws from Daniel
value.description: Rosa silently removes her hand from the sewing machine and passes Daniel without looking at him, a gesture that visibly wounds him.
evidence: Rosa nodded once and lifted her hand from the sewing machine. The lifting was slow, as if she were taking her hand off something living.

She passed Daniel in the doorway without looking at him, which was perhaps the most cutting thing Asha had seen any person in this house do to any other person, and Daniel felt it; she saw him feel it; she watched the small muscle along his jaw move and resettle.

value.name: Asha invites Lucia to join the search
value.description: In the hallway, Asha asks Lucia to come with them as they continue searching the house.
evidence: In the hallway Asha turned to Lucia. "Would you come with us."

value.name: Daniel insists on searching together
value.description: Daniel objects to being left in the hallway and insists that if the house is being searched, everyone should search together.
evidence: "All of us," Daniel said. His voice had gotten a little hard at the edges. "If we're searching the house we're searching the house together. I'm not going to stand in the hallway while my sister and the housekeeper give the lawyer a tour."

value.name: Group begins house search
value.description: The four of them move through the house together in an awkward line, with Rosa leading the search.
evidence: They went through the house in a slow, awkward four-person line. Rosa led.

value.name: Rosa moves through house familiarly
value.description: Rosa navigates the rooms with intimate familiarity, suggesting she knows the house as if it were part of her own body.
